### Describe the bug I found that `prompt_logprobs` for the same fixed token prompts can change when the same prompts are scored in a different batch order. This is a scoring-only repro: no sampling path is involved. Each prompt is fixed token ids, and logprobs are read via `lp_dict[token_id].logprob`. With `enable_prefix_caching=True` (default), reordering the requests changes per-token logprobs for the same prompt.
